project.title: Original removable purge-waste bin for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max

coordinate_frame.origin: center of bin outer bottom plane
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y toward high rear shield and printer

requirements.statement: Catch purge waste without entering the printer motion envelope.
requirements.verification: physical full-travel and three-cycle purge test

requirements.statement: Use an original design and no third-party model geometry.
Remain support-free with 0.4 mm nozzle PETG defaults.
Carry metriMade branding and literal metrimade.com text with up to four logo colors.
Unknown machine hole spacing shall be isolated from the large print through a low-cost fit gauge and adjustable bracket.
requirements.verification: gauge fit and measured hole spacing

global_style.summary: restrained rounded utility form with navy body and metriMade four-color side badges
global_style.generation_material: navy PETG body; color-matched PETG or PLA badge
global_style.detail_hierarchy: functional catch envelope first, removable interface second, branding third

assembly_sequence: Print and verify the machine-side fit gauge.
Print and install the bracket with verified M3 hardware.
Print the bin upright and engage both rim hooks.
Print one or two four-color badges and bond them to clean side faces.
Run full-motion and supervised purge tests before unattended use.

decision_log.topic: Machine screw spacing and local keep-out
decision_log.current_basis: Official guide confirms screws and positioning holes but gives no spacing.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Printed gauge fit and physical measurement.

decision_log.current_basis: Official bundle lists M3x7; a 3.2 mm added plate suggests M3x10 as a starting point.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Verify thread engagement and no bottoming on the printer.

decision_log.current_basis: Balanced provides 1.86 l geometric capacity at about 263 g PETG and fits the official build area.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Slicer time/material comparison remains useful but does not change the selected geometry.
